$comment: brobot-admin-ui's identity is brobot's, the same palette as apps/brobot-client (the streamer's desktop app): brobot's violet seed (a nod to Twitch's #9146ff, deliberately not that hue), the shared warning orange as tertiary, and a cool near-black neutral with a violet cast. Dark by default, like the Twitch page it is linked from. The typeface is the system UI stack: nothing to download for a site viewers open from a chat link. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @singularity/brobot-admin-ui run gen:theme`; the WCAG AA gate runs on every pair and refuses to write a failing palette.
name: brobot-admin-ui

type.mono: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
